text: That green square is one single output unit of the convolution, at the top-left corner of the 3×3 map.
All nine pixels in the red 3×3 patch funnel into it — the red arrows are those nine local links.
The green frame around it is the 3×3 output map, one cell per position the kernel lands on.
So it's just one activation: the sum of those nine pixels times the same kernel K, plus a bias.
